minor_issue.description: health_check inside diagnostic_general ToolExecutor context returns empty data (Health: ? | version=? | sessions=?). The tool succeeds but the /health HTTP call gets no response data when called from the server process itself. This is a pre-existing limitation of the health_check tool when called from within the server process (loopback HTTP). Not a regression. git_status and list_directory work correctly.
